Our routes take shape in winter at the map table and in summer in the saddle: which track holds after the snowmelt, where the water is clean, which lodge at 4,000 m really heats. That is why we show the highlights publicly — the full route goes to the people who ride with us.

It all started with Vikram: he grew up in Manali and has been in the saddle for twenty years, first as a mechanic, then as a guide. He rides every new route alone before the season — with a tent, tools and no timetable. Anne joined in 2016 as a guest and stayed on as tour leader; Pemba has been leading our trips in Nepal since 2019. The three of us are the entire team: whoever books rides with one of us — not with an agency that passes the job on.
